description.value: Victoria's first and only Italian bakery, established in 1978 and now operated across three generations of the Pozzolo family. The shop produces organic sourdough breads, Northern Italian pastries, cakes, gelato, and frozen meals, and offers both eat-in table service and take-away. A characterful Quadra Street stop where a touring cyclist can pick up fresh artisan bread, a croissant, or a sit-down coffee.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: staple (4 spaces) at 11m. Total: 4 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and fully corroborates the OSM address (3197 Quadra Street Victoria, BC V8X 1E9) and phone (250-388-4557). The site confirms the bakery is open Tues–Sat and describes a functioning eat-in and take-away food operation including organic breads, pastries, frozen meals, gelato, and table-service coffee. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any other cyclist-specific infrastructure appears anywhere in the OSM tags or website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible specialty food business with confirmed contact details and a functioning website; a practical food resupply stop for touring cyclists.

Hot food.detail: Website states the bakery has 'grown from baked goods… to meals to eat-in-or-go options' with table service and locally roasted coffee served sit-down or to-go
